name: Thoracic Disc Herniation
definition: Displacement of thoracic disc material that may cause axial pain, thoracic radiculopathy or spinal cord compression; many thoracic disc herniations are asymptomatic.

typical: Myelopathic gait or leg symptoms if cord compressed

investigations.MRI: Thoracic MRI is preferred for cord/disc assessment.
investigations.radiographs: CT can characterize calcified disc/bony anatomy.

green: Conservative management for stable nonmyelopathic cases
amber: Progressive cord compression or major deficit requires spine surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Prishtha-shoola phenotype may be documented; structural thoracic disc disease remains a modern diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Displacement of thoracic disc material that may cause axial pain, thoracic radiculopathy or spinal cord compression; many thoracic disc herniations are asymptomatic.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
